reviewNotes: Twenty-five item-category, game-mode, scarecrow, hopper, discovery, and placement strings were translated directly from English. Two full editorial audits cover approved category and item terms, established mode labels, placeholders and counts, discovery-message tone, planting constraints, punctuation, and capitalization; both found no remaining objective issue.

Object.cs.12926.source: I haven't encountered any crows yet.
Object.cs.12926.translation: Nu am întâlnit încă nicio cioară.

Object.cs.12942.source: The hopper is empty. Build a silo and cut grass with your scythe to refill it.
Object.cs.12942.translation: Buncărul este gol. Construiește un siloz și taie iarba cu coasa pentru a-l umple din nou.

Object.cs.12993.source: You found an artifact! The curator of the local museum might want to know about this.
Object.cs.12993.translation: Ai găsit un artefact! S-ar putea ca administratorul muzeului local să vrea să afle despre el.

Object.cs.12994.source: You found a 'Lost Book'. The library's collection has expanded!
Object.cs.12994.translation: Ai găsit o „Carte pierdută”. Colecția bibliotecii s-a mărit!

Object.cs.12995.source: You found a 'Geode'! The local blacksmith can break it open for you. Who knows what might be hidden inside?
Object.cs.12995.translation: Ai găsit o „Geodă”! Fierarul local o poate sparge pentru tine. Cine știe ce s-ar putea ascunde înăuntru?

Object.cs.12996.source: You found a peculiar statue behind Grandpa's Shrine.
Object.cs.12996.translation: Ai găsit o statuie ciudată în spatele Altarului Bunicului.
